title: An etale rational parameter for a valued smooth function field
statement: Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-kun-separably-closed, def-weil-field], let $R\subseteq K$ be a valuation ring with fraction field $K$, and suppose its prime ideals form a finite chain. Let $L/K$ be a finitely generated field extension of transcendence degree one [def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Let $W\subseteq L$ be a valuation ring with fraction field $L$ such that $W\cap K=R$. Here a valuation ring in a field $F$ is a subring $A$ such that for every $z\in F^\times$, either $z$ or $z^{-1}$ belongs to $A$. Put $KW=(R\setminus\{0\})^{-1}W\subseteq L$. Assume that there are a smooth integral $K$-scheme $C$ of finite type and dimension one [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], an identification of its function field $k(C)$ with $L$, and a $K$-morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(KW)\to C$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] inducing this identification at the generic point. Then there is $t\in W$, transcendental over $K$, such that $L$ is finite over $F=K(t)$ and the inclusion $W\cap F\hookrightarrow W$ is etale, meaning that $\operatorname{Spec}W\to\operatorname{Spec}(W\cap F)$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. The function field of an integral scheme is its local ring at the generic point.
